parameters.query:
SELECT d.status
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS tn) q
LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON d.tracking_number = q.tn
UPDATE deliveries SET scheduled_date = $1::date WHERE tracking_number = $2 RETURNING scheduled_date

parameters.jsCode:
const base = $('Process Reschedule State').item.json;
return [{ json: { ...base, reply: `Your delivery ${base.context.tracking_number} has been rescheduled to ${base.context.requested_date}.`, next_state: 'COMPLETED' } }];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO escalations (customer_id, delivery_id, reason, priority)
VALUES ($1, (SELECT id FROM deliveries WHERE tracking_number = $2), $3, 'MEDIUM')
RETURNING id

INSERT INTO conversations (id, customer_id, current_intent, current_state, context, is_active)
VALUES (COALESCE($1::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), $2, 'RESCHEDULE_DELIVERY', $3, $4::jsonb, $5)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  current_intent = EXCLUDED.current_intent,
  current_state = EXCLUDED.current_state,
  context = EXCLUDED.context,
  is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING id

INSERT INTO messages (customer_id, conversation_id, direction, body, intent, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'OUTBOUND', $3, 'RESCHEDULE_DELIVERY', 'PROCESSED')
INSERT INTO audit_logs (event_type, entity_type, entity_id, details) VALUES ($1, 'customer', $2, $3::jsonb)
